scenes.headline: How a diffusion language model writes by unmasking
scenes.sub: Masks, a weighted fill-in loss, confident unmasking and block diffusion
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Dewdrop! This language model starts from blanks and fills them in, not left to right.

scenes.text: Train one bidirectional Transformer to fill in any fraction of masked tokens, then generate by unmasking a few confident tokens per pass.
scenes.mark: unmasking a few confident tokens per pass
scenes.say: Train one Transformer to fill in any fraction of blanks, then write by unmasking the confident ones.

scenes.title: The loss: fill in the blanks
scenes.say: Training is fill in the blanks.

parts.note: predict the original token at every masked position
parts.say: Mask each token with probability t, and predict every original at once.

parts.note: every mask ratio from 0 to 1, each weighted by 1/t
parts.say: t covers every ratio, and dividing by t makes the loss a bound on likelihood.

scenes.label: parameters in LLaDA 8B, in an autoregressive Transformer's exact shapes
scenes.note: 32 blocks, 4,096 wide, no causal mask, no timestep input
scenes.say: LLaDA's eight billion parameters have exactly the shapes of a left-to-right model. That's why Dream could start from an existing one.

steps.say: Append masks to the prompt, and run the whole sequence through once.
Every masked slot gets a prediction and a confidence, reading both sides.
Commit the most confident. Those are never revisited.

steps.note: as many steps as tokens: one per pass
steps.say: Remask the rest, and run again.

steps.label: Autoregressive: each token reads only its past
steps.note: the past never changes, so its keys and values cache exactly
steps.say: A left-to-right model reads only the past, which never changes, so it caches keys and values.

steps.label: Masked diffusion: every token reads every token
steps.note: each commit moves every key and value
steps.say: Here every token reads every other, so each commit moves every key and value. Each step is a full pass.

scenes.title: Block diffusion brings the cache back

left.title: Whole-sequence diffusion
left.say: Diffusing the whole answer means full passes and a fixed length.

right.title: Block diffusion
items: Finished blocks cache exactly, any length
right.say: Block diffusion runs left to right over blocks. Finished blocks never change, so they cache exactly.

scenes.title: Tokens committed per step, LLaDA-1.5 on GSM8K
scenes.note: reported by the Flash-dLLM paper, 512 generated tokens
scenes.say: Speed comes from committing several tokens per pass: about three with a confidence threshold, nearly six with self-checking.

scenes.text: A Transformer without its causal mask, trained to fill any blanks; its speed is how many it can commit per pass.
scenes.say: A Transformer without its causal mask, trained to fill any blanks. Its speed is how many it can commit per pass.

Block diffusion: exact caches, any length
